== Biography ==
George was born about Nov 1849 in Georgia to [[Glasgow-405|Wilson Glasgow]] and [[Bohannon-337|Celia Bohannon]].  He married [[Beasley-1204|Joisey Beasley]] 16 October 1876 in what was Sanford County, Alabama, present day Lamar County, Alabama.  He passed away before 1840.  <ref>Information obtained by [[Atkins-2361|Mary Atkins]]. </ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-405]] is assessed at 91% (proved). George W's 1870 entry in W A's household, earlier 1850/1860 census citations and a consistent 1849 Georgia birth form a coherent Wilson/Celia child sequence. His 1876 marriage supports the adult identity; the biography's before 1840 death is an obvious unresolved contradiction to those records.

Selected Glasgow-405 fatherhood of Glasgow-398; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Compare 1850–1870 households with George's death parent entry.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MHK1-W42 "United States Census, 1870", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:MHK1-W42 : 28 May 2021), George W Glassgow in entry for W A Glassgow, 1870.].
